# Essence of Rome

> > Expert-guided private tours revealing Rome's ancient monuments, Baroque masterpieces, and hidden historical treasures through art, architecture, and archaeology.

Essence of Rome offers specialized private guided tours throughout Rome and surrounding areas, focusing on major sites like the Colosseum, Roman Forum, Borghese Gallery, and Vatican, as well as lesser-known gems. The site features both tour offerings and in-depth blog articles exploring Roman history, Baroque art (especially Bernini), ancient architecture, and fascinating historical details.

## Key Topics

- Ancient Rome
- Colosseum
- Roman Forum
- Gian Lorenzo Bernini

- Triumphal Arches
- Sant'Angelo Castle

## Private Guided Tours

- [Tours in Rome - Essence of Rome](https://www.essenceofrome.com/tours): Main tours page listing all private guided tours in Rome
- [Borghese Gallery - Essence of Rome expert guided tours](https://www.essenceofrome.com/tour/borghese-gallery): Private guided tour of Borghese Gallery featuring Bernini and Caravaggio
- [Hadrian's Villa and Villa D'Este Private Tour](https://www.essenceofrome.com/tour/hadrians-villa-and-villa-deste-tour): Full-day private tour of Hadrian's Villa and Villa D'Este in Tivoli
- [Sant'Angelo Castle and Pantheon Private Tour](https://www.essenceofrome.com/tour/santangelo-castle-and-pantheon): 3-hour private tour of Castel Sant'Angelo and Pantheon with panoramic views
- [Food and Wine Tours in Rome](https://www.essenceofrome.com/tour-category/food-and-wine-tours): Food, wine tasting, and cooking class tours in Rome's neighborhoods

## Ancient Roman Monuments & Architecture

- [The Arch of Septimius Severus advertising in marble](https://www.essenceofrome.com/the-arch-of-septimius-severus-advertising-in-marble): Triumphal Arch of Septimius Severus at Roman Forum as imperial propaganda
- [Colosseum: the numbers engraved on the arches were red](https://www.essenceofrome.com/colosseum-the-numbers-engraved-on-the-arches-were-red): Colosseum restoration reveals red-painted entrance numbers on arches
- [Ludus Magnus - the gladiator's gym](https://www.essenceofrome.com/ludus-magnus-the-gladiators-gym): Ludus Magnus gladiatorial training school beside the Colosseum
- [Roman Domus and Villas](https://www.essenceofrome.com/roman-domus-and-villas): Ancient Roman wealthy housing: Domus architecture and villa layouts explained
- [The owl on the equestrian statue of Marcus Aurelius](https://www.essenceofrome.com/the-owl-of-marcus-aurelius): Legend of the owl on Marcus Aurelius equestrian statue at Campidoglio

## Baroque Art & Bernini Masterpieces

- [St. Peter's special effects](https://www.essenceofrome.com/st-peters-special-effects): Optical illusions and architectural tricks at St. Peter's Square by Bernini
- [Minerva's 'chick' is an elephant](https://www.essenceofrome.com/minervas-chick-is-an-elephant): Roman nickname 'Minerva's chick' for Bernini's elephant obelisk sculpture
- [Two horses represent the ocean - Trevi Fountain details](https://www.essenceofrome.com/two-horses-represent-the-ocean-amazing-details-of-the-trevi-fountain): Trevi Fountain horses symbolizing ocean moods by architect Nicola Salvi
- [The legend of the Lover's Fountain in Rome](https://www.essenceofrome.com/the-legend-of-the-lovers-fountain-in-rome): Hidden Lover's Fountain legend beside Trevi Fountain in Rome

## Papal & Vatican History

- [The Basilica of Saint Paul and the Pope's portraits](https://www.essenceofrome.com/the-basilica-of-saint-paul-and-the-popes-portraits): Papal portrait mosaics at Basilica of Saint Paul tracing apostolic line
- [Leo the Great and Attila - the meeting that saved Rome](https://www.essenceofrome.com/leo-the-great-and-attila-the-meeting-that-saved-rome): Raphael fresco depicting Pope Leo I meeting Attila the Hun in Vatican
- [The Sack of Rome](https://www.essenceofrome.com/the-sack-of-rome): 1527 Sack of Rome by Emperor Charles V's troops through Vatican Walls

## Hidden Rome & Curiosities

- [The first comic strip (and bad word) in history](https://www.essenceofrome.com/the-first-comic-strip-and-bad-word-in-history): Ancient vernacular fresco comic strip at San Clemente church near Colosseum
- [Canale Monterano](https://www.essenceofrome.com/canale-monterano): Ghost town Canale Monterano with Bernini ruins near Rome and Bracciano lake
- [The Italian Republic Day in Rome](https://www.essenceofrome.com/the-italian-republic-day-in-rome): June 2nd Italian Republic Day celebrations and events in Rome
